sentences.en: The green plants take in carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 绿色植物从大气中吸收二氧化碳。

sentences.en: This tells you how much carbon dioxide the building emits.
sentences.zh: 这告诉了你这座建筑排放了多少二氧化碳。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to make significant decreases of carbon dioxide emission.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要大幅减少二氧化碳排放。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：di（二）+oxide（氧化物）→二氧化物
